correctness.rationale: The exact distribution follows by conditioning on the first two Gaussian sketch columns and integrating a two-dimensional Wishart-normal mixture with density (s-1)/(2pi)(1+||v||^2)^(-(s+1)/2). Direct matrix algebra gives the parabolic discriminant inequality. Polar integration yields a one-dimensional formula for every integer s>=3. The large-s limit is justified via a positive 2D integrable majorant and dominated convergence, with explicit Gaussian/exponential integrals producing prefactor q/(h sqrt(3pi)). Positive-definiteness and the honest sketching regime n>s are checked. The extracted standalone executable passed 59,018 supplementary checks, none substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Nonreal reduced Ritz pairs force real Schur two-by-two blocks and affect eigenpair extraction from symmetric data. The theorem gives an exact failure incidence and a sharp exponential sample-size law for a fixed SPD matrix and arbitrary ambient dimension, including proper dimensional reduction s<n. It separates finite-s positive risk from asymptotic suppression and identifies the gap-to-coupling ratio as the structural control parameter. These outputs are more than a qualitative counterexample or trivial fixed-coefficient computation. Limits: independent real Gaussians, equal-coupling two-state trial model and exact arithmetic.
